nuggets.text: The RedHawks' Cradle of Coaches produced Woody Hayes, Bo Schembechler and Ara Parseghian.
The RedHawks' rivalry with Cincinnati dates to 1888 and is tied for the oldest in FBS football.
The RedHawks' opener at Pitt was the first meeting between the schools since 1949.
The RedHawks opened at Acrisure Stadium, where Miami alum Ben Roethlisberger starred during 18 NFL seasons with the Steelers.
Chuck Martin's Grand Valley State teams won back-to-back Division II national titles and 40 games in a row from 2005 to 2007.
Scoop Smith, a 5-foot-5 freshman from Pittsburgh, got the RedHawks' season started with a 55-yard kick return in his hometown.
Kansas transfer David McComb's first college touchdown pass went 75 yards to Ohio State transfer Damarion Witten.
Chuck Martin was Notre Dame's offensive coordinator in 2012, when the Irish went 12-0 and reached the BCS title game.
The RedHawks reached the 2025 MAC Championship Game after going 6-2 in conference play.
Saturday is the RedHawks' home opener and the first meeting ever between Miami and Holy Cross.
